description: This file defines a SwiftUI View called SessionMenuLabelView that displays a menu label with contextual information, including a usage bar, label text, token summary, age text, and a chevron icon. It also introduces an environment property to track menu item highlighting.

classes.name: SessionMenuLabelView
classes.description: A SwiftUI View representing a labeled menu item with contextual tokens, age, and a visual indicator, customizable based on highlight state.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the view hierarchy for SessionMenuLabelView, composing a vertical stack with a usage bar and a horizontal text/info row.

calls: ContextUsageBar(usedTokens: self.row.tokens.total, contextTokens: self.row.tokens.contextTokens, width: max(1, self.width - (self.paddingLeading + self.paddingTrailing)), height: self.barHeight)
